scope: Theorem 1.1: an unconditional, zero-error Las Vegas algorithm on a fixed uniform probabilistic multitape Turing machine with a read-once tape of fair coin flips. For every integer N >= 2 it halts with probability 1 and outputs the exact complete prime factorization, certified by AKS primality testing and multiplication. The worst-case expected number of bit operations is at most L_N[1/3, 105] = exp((105+o(1))(ln N)^(1/3)(ln ln N)^(2/3)), and the worst-case deterministic workspace is at most L_N[1/3, 40]. On this board that is 2^{b^{1/3+o(1)}}, theta 1/3 whatever the constant; the leading constant is 105.

authors_statement: The README says the paper and its Lean 4 formalization were entirely obtained by Cogentic, an agentic framework using Gemini 4, with no human interaction other than the initial prompt. The Cogentic harness was built by Yang Cai, Vineet Gupta, Yanchen Jiang, Christopher Liaw, Aranyak Mehta, Grigoris Velegkas and Di Wang (Google Research and Google DeepMind). The arXiv number in the README (2609.40324) is the Cogentic framework preprint, not this paper.
